log.title: KAYNES: Press release
log.message: Kaynes reported H1 FY27 revenue of Rs 18,987 million, up 18% YoY, with an order book exceeding INR 100,000 million.

log.title: Example: KAYNES: Q2 FY27 results
log.message: Revenue ₹953 cr (+4.4% YoY), EBITDA ₹126 cr (−16.2% YoY), PAT ₹45.4 cr (−61.6% YoY).
